# Remotion Maps

Knowledge for animating maps in Remotion videos: the main file routes to exactly one of five self-contained techniques — a static map image animated on top, Mapbox (which requires your own Mapbox access token if you choose it), MapLibre (no API key, fully free), MapTiler (annotations over borders, rivers and labels, using your own MapTiler key if you choose it), and CesiumJS 3D terrain flythroughs (MapTiler or Google Maps key depending on the mode). Key-free techniques exist, so no key is needed unless you pick a provider technique. It works in the user's own Remotion project with local commands; no licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing. Curated by Skill Harbor — Remotion Maps, by @remotion-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
